## History

Tillie Boulter is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During a school day, she sits in the classroom alongside her peers before Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) disciplines [Anne](../character/anne.md) by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
